paper_title: Computational Fun with Sturdy and Flimsy Numbers
classifications: Theory of computation → Grammars and context-free languages
statement: It would be interesting to understand the distribution of values of msw(n) and mfw(n) for n flimsy. We leave this as an open problem.
context: We have shown that techniques from automata theory can be used to solve problems in number theory. For other fun along these lines, see [7, 22]. It would be interesting to understand the distribution of values of msw(n) and mfw(n) for n flimsy. We leave this as an open problem.
